tuning_key.text: You know you know this so get up and shout / That's what life is about
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: There is something already known in the bones before the mind can catch up, and today it wants to move. Let it out loud—the hum, the shout, the unedited noise of a joy that stops asking for permission. What returns is not a straight line but a bright scatter of sparks, each finding its own irregular rhythm. This is the unplanned harmony that celebrates itself: the sound of what life is about, finally playing at full volume.

practice.title: Soften the Instrument
practice.instruction: Drop the shoulders, unclench the jaw, and let one unshaped exhale fall out of the mouth like a weight you no longer need to carry.

practice.title: Permit the Noise
practice.instruction: Allow one sound—any sound—to rise from the chest or belly without editing it for meaning, volume, or beauty.

practice.title: Receive the Echo
practice.instruction: Cue the echo audio and let the bright scatter manifest through you: irregular rhythm, unplanned harmony, and the full-volume noise of what life is about.
